name: terminal-notify
description: Desktop notifications through your terminal when Claude Code finishes, asks a question or needs a permission. From the makers of Agent Terminal (https://4nuva.dev/agent-terminal/), which also forwards them to your phone.

format.title: Notification sequence
format.description: auto picks one for your terminal. osc777: Agent Terminal, Ghostty, Warp, urxvt, Windows Terminal 1.26+. osc9: iTerm2, WezTerm, ConEmu. osc99: kitty. all: all three, for a terminal auto does not know (one that reads several shows several). bell: the terminal bell only. off: no notifications.

details.title: Show details
details.description: Include the session name, the start of Claude's reply, the command or file a permission is for, and the question. Off shows only the event and the project folder. Known key and token formats are masked either way.

idle_reminder.title: Idle reminder
idle_reminder.description: Notify again when the prompt has waited 60 seconds for a reply.

in_progress_replies.title: In-progress replies
in_progress_replies.description: Notify when a turn ends while background agents or commands keep running (In-progress reply). Off notifies only for turns that leave nothing running.

ring_bell.title: Ring the bell too
ring_bell.description: Also ring the terminal bell with each notification, so the terminal marks the tab. Windows Terminal rings it as the profile's bellStyle sets, which can include a sound and a second notification.

node.title: Node.js executable
node.description: The Node.js executable the hooks run. The default, node, is looked up on PATH. Set a full path when Node.js is not on PATH, for example node.exe in the folder `mise where node` prints.
